answer: Prayers & Duties >> Qurbani (Slaughtering) Question ID: 46404 Country: India Title: Aqeeqa Meat Question: Some people say that while performing aqiqah of a child the parents should not eat the meat of the slaughtered animal unless meat of some other animal is mixed while cooking. How far is this true? Please reply in the light of Quran and Sunnah. Answer ID: 46404 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1137/1082/N=9/1434) It is wrong. The parents, grandfather and grandmother of the child etc may eat the meat of aqiqah. It is mentioned in Fatawa Darul Uloom Deoband (15:625) that as per the Hanafi Fiqh the meat of aqiqah carries the same ruling as of qurbani. As the meat of qurbani is consumed by all the family members and relatives in the same way they may eat aqiqah meat. It is alright for mother, father, grandfather and grandmother and others to eat it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
